info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: jYAne gArayate, girennigaraRe, Sabde gfRAti trayaM yuktaM, gro garatIti sekavizaye hrasvAntaDAtoH Sapi ' (Slo. 33) iti devaH .

examples: 'pra mitre DAma varuRe gfRAntaH' (f॰1.152.5). pragfRanta udGozayantaH saMSabdayantaH kIrtayanta ityarTaH.
'na saKyamindro'sunvatA saNgfRIta' (f॰4.25.7). anupagacCatItyAha.
'yadadAsyannA uta saNgfRAmi (aTarva॰6.119.1). saNgfRAmi=pratijAne dAsyAmIti.

'yadannamadmyanftena devA dAsyannadAsyannuta saNgfRAmi' (aTarva॰6.71.3). ukto'rTaH. saNgfRAmi nigirAmIti saMskftaSArmaRyakozakArO. ayaM ca tayormahitayorviBramaH. sampUrvo gfRAtiH pratiSAne rUQaH. rUQiM ca pratyanAdaro na yuktaH. sAyaRo'pyatrEva sUkte smAha- sampUrvo guRAtiH pratijYAyAM vartata iti.
'nityaM SabdaM saNgirate' (pA॰1.3.52 sUtravfttO). pratijAnIta ityAha.
'vasUni deSAMSca nivartayizyan rAmaM nfpaH saNgiramARa eva. tayA'vajajYe…' (Bawwi॰3.8).. ukto'rTaH.
'yaTAsvaM saNgirante sma goptIzu svAmino guRAn' (Bawwi॰8.31). aByupagacCanti=sammanasaH santo vadantIti tAtparyam.

'mandAkrAntA…tAM saNgirante' (Sruta॰).. Ekamatyena vyapadiSantItyAha. atra pratijYAne'rTe giratestOdAdikasya prayogo vyavahAraBraMSakfta ityasmABirvyAkaraRacandrodaye tiNantaprakaraRe sapramARamupapAditamiti tata evAvasAtavyam.
'yadgigAmi saNgirAmi samudra iva saNgiraH' (aTarva॰6.135.3). saNgirAmi=samyaggirAmi=nigirAmi.

'saKA saKyurna praminAti saNgiraH' (aTarva॰18.4.60). saKA (somaH) aBizavastotrAdinA saKiBUtasya yazwuH saNgiraH saNgIryamARAni idameva PalaM somAdeva laBeyetyevaM pratijYAyamAnAni kAmyamAnAni vastUni (sAyaRaH).
'dakziRAnAM ca saNgare Gnan DarmeRa na duzyati' (manu0 8.349). saNgaro'varoDa iti meDAtiTiH. dakziRADanagavAdyapahAranimitte saMgare saMgrAme iti kullUkaH.
'yadevEnAH sampragIrya hotrA ityAcakzate tena samAH' (E0 brA0 6.13). sampragIrya=saMjYAM kftvA, vyapadiSya.
'yayA cidviSve vasavo gfRanti' (f0 7.38.3). AgfRanti praSaMsanti, stuvanti.
'A yasya te mahimAnaM SatamUte Satakrato gIrBirgfRanti kAravaH' (f0 8.46.3). ukto'rTaH.
'pUrvamevoditamuttareRABigfRAti' (tE0 saM0 5.1.4.19). aBigfRAti=anuvadati.
'aBi yaM (sarvaM) devyaditi rguRAti' (f0 7.38.4). aBigfRAti stavIti, juzate vA.
'aBi yajYaM gfRIhi naH' (f0 1.15.3). aBigfRIhi=aBirocaya=aBinanda=juzasva.
'tAM tvA viSve aBigfRantu devAH' (vA0 saM0 14.4). ukto'rTaH.
'viSvAvasuraBi tanno gfRAtu' (f0 10.139.5).
'ehi stomA~ aBi svarA'Bi gfRIhyA ruva' (f0 1.10.4).
'imAM vAcamaBi viSve gfRantaH' (vA0 saM0 2.18). stuvanta ityarTaH.
'antarvedyaBigaro bahirvedyapagaraH' (vArAha SrO0 3.2.5.33). aBinandatA praSaMsatA ftvijA''hvAnamaBigaraH.
'viSve tad devA aBisaMgfRantu' (kO0 sU0 115). pratiSfRvantu pratijAnatAm. sampUrvo gfRAtiH pratijYAne vartate.
'prati vAM sUra udite mitraM gfRIze varuRam' (f0 7.66.7). pratigfRIze upahvayasi, stOzi.
'prati zImagnirjarate samidDaH. prati viprAso matiBirgfRantaH' (f0 7.78.2).. ukto'rTaH.
'SaMsAvADvaryo prati me gfRIhi' (f0 3.53.3). pratigfRIhi prativAcaM brUhi.
'omunnaya havya deveByaH pApmano mAm ityuccEH pratigfRAti' (BA0 SrO0 6.11.2). pratiSaMsatItyarTaH.
'hotre'nugfRAti hotre pratigfRAti. hotAraM SaMsantaM protsAhayatItyarTa iti anupratigfRaSca' (pA0 1.4.41) iti sUtre vfttiH.
'omAmodEza ityAdiko hoturutsAhajananaH pratigaraH' (ASva0 SrO0 7.11).
'om ityaDvaryuH pratigaraM pratigfRAti' (tE0 saM0 1.8.1). ukto'rTaH.

'pratyagfRAttasmE lakzmaRaH' (mugDa-boDavyAkaraRe). ityudAharanmugDo bopadevo vftti-viroDAdupekzyaH. pratiSaMsane hotfkarmake'Dvaryukartfke pratiniyataH pratigfRAtirananyavizayaH. anugaraH pratigaraH SaMsituH (hotuH) protsAhane vartate iti pA0 1.4.41 sUtre vfttiH.
'gfRAti ha vA etadDotA yacCaMsati. tasmA etad gfRate pratyevADvaryurAgfRAti tasmAtpratigaro nAma' (Sa0 brA0 4.3.2.1). nigadavyAKyAtam.
'aDvaryustasmiMstizWan pratyAgfRAti' (SAM0 SrO0 17.4.6). pratyAgfRAti prativakti.
'upa ye tvA gfRanti vahnayaH' (f0 1.48.11). upagfRanti stuvanta AkArayanti upahvayante. vahnayo yajYanirvAhakAH.
'dayAnuvfttyA ca nAma te kftyapakzam …upagfRIte' (avadA0 jA0 23). upagfRIta upadiSati.
